title: How likely are you to recommend {product}? A 2-minute check-in
description: One score, one reason, and a few quick questions so the {team} knows what to improve next.
audience: Customers who have used {product} in the last 3 months
purpose: Decide which one or two improvements to {product} to prioritise next quarter, based on what separates promoters from detractors

welcome.title: Two minutes to shape {product}
welcome.description:
We're the {team} at {company}. Your answers tell us what to improve next, and we'll share what we heard and what we're changing.
• For anyone who has used {product} in the last 3 months
• Takes about 2 minutes
• Anonymous: only the {team} sees answers, in summary
• Voluntary: you can stop at any time
• Open until {date}. Questions? {contact}

thank_you.title: Thank you, that's everything
thank_you.description: We read every answer. We'll share a summary of what we heard, and what we'll change, within a month of {date}. Questions? {contact}

questions.label: Have you used {product} in the last 3 months?
How likely are you to recommend {product} to a friend or colleague?
What is the main reason for your score?
questions.description: A sentence or two is plenty.

questions.label: In the last 3 months, how often have you used {product}?
options: Every day or almost every day

questions.label: Which one of these would improve {product} most for you?
Which best describes how you use {product}?
questions.description: So we can compare answers between personal and team use.
options: On my own, for personal use
